changelog:
- Adds a Favro skill that routes all Favro work through the OOMOL `oo` CLI connector.
- Supports reading Favro organizations, collections, widgets, boards, and cards.
- Supports creating cards in boards or the configured user’s todo list.
- Supports updating selected fields on existing Favro cards.
- Includes schema-first usage guidance and safety rules for write actions.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@46cfb3e`
summary: Favro (favro.com). Use this skill for ANY Favro request — reading, creating, and updating data. Whenever a task involves Favro, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
